instruction: Look at gui_009_hinge_leaf.step in SolidWorks, a hinge leaf with a 90 x 32 x 3 mm flat plate spanning X=-45 to X=45, Y=-16 to Y=16, and Z=0 to Z=3. Open SOLIDWORKS 2025 from its desktop shortcut, then load `gui_009_hinge_leaf.step`. Three existing hinge knuckles lie along the Y=16 long edge; they have outside diameter 8 mm, axis along X, centerline at Y=12 and Z=6.8, and X spans -45 to -20, -10 to 10, and 20 to 45. Add four countersunk mounting holes on the leaf plate at X=-33, -11, 11, and 33 with Y=0. Each hole has a 4.5 mm through diameter, 8.5 mm countersink top diameter, and 90 degree countersink angle. Also adjust the hinge pin bore through all knuckles to diameter 4.2 mm. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_009_hinge_leaf_out.step.
